name: Image to Text
searchTerms: ocr image to text screenshot capture d'écran texte
hubBlurb: Pull text out of a screenshot or scan with a bundled AI model.
tileDescription: Pull text from a screenshot or scan.
seoDescription: Extract text from a screenshot, photo, or scan with a bundled AI model that runs entirely on your machine.
directAnswer: Umbra's Image to Text tool pulls text out of a screenshot, photo, or scan using a bundled AI model that runs entirely on your machine — the image never leaves it, not even for this.
body: Drop an image anywhere in the window, or paste one with ⌘V, and Umbra recognizes and extracts its text — selectable directly on the image, or copied as plain text in one action. If nothing readable is found, it says so plainly.
screenshotAlt: Umbra's Image to Text tool showing recognized text selectable directly on top of a scanned image.

faqs.q: Why not use a free online OCR tool?
faqs.a: An online OCR tool means uploading your image — screenshots and photos often contain exactly what you'd least want on a stranger's server. Umbra's model is bundled with the app; nothing is uploaded, even for this.

faqs.q: Is this the AI feature the site mentions?
faqs.a: Yes — the only one that ships today: a local OCR model with no network call involved.

faqs.q: Can I select the text directly on a screenshot, not just copy a text dump?
faqs.a: Yes — recognized text stays selectable right on top of the image itself, and you can search within it with match navigation, rather than working from a separate plain-text box that's lost its layout.
